task.request: Buy a dock for my USB-C laptop that runs two 4K 60 Hz displays, under 150 dollars. Let me review the order before you place it.

events.text: Buy a dock for my USB-C laptop that runs two 4K 60 Hz displays, under 150 dollars. Let me review the order before you place it.

events.request_text: Visitor has a USB-C laptop. Confirm from your store records: laptop port type, number of displays that must run at 4K 60 Hz (visitor needs 2), and budget in US dollars (under $150). Then quote one unit of a dock you have checked as compatible with USB-C and two 4K 60 Hz displays within that budget. Include quote_id, product name, the compatibility checks it passed, and total price.

tools.name: search_products
tools.description: List the store's docking stations with price in US cents and specs. A spec the store has not filled in is null and is named in missing_specs.

query.description: What the shopper is looking for, in plain language.

max_price_cents.description: Highest price to include, in US cents.

tools.name: check_compatibility
tools.description: Check one docking station against the shopper's laptop and displays. Returns compatible, incompatible or unknown, with one line per check and the specs the store is missing.

laptop_port.description: The laptop port the dock plugs into.

displays_at_4k60.description: How many external displays must run at 4K 60 Hz at the same time.

min_power_delivery_w.description: Watts the laptop needs from the dock, if it charges through it.

tools.name: prepare_order
tools.description: Quote a demo order for one product at the current price. Places nothing. Show the quote to the visitor and ask them to confirm before confirm_demo_order.

tools.name: confirm_demo_order
tools.description: Place the simulated order for a quote, only after the visitor has seen the quote and confirmed it. Nothing is charged or shipped.

confirmed_by_visitor.description: True only when the visitor confirmed this quote in the conversation.

arguments.query: docking station USB-C supporting two external 4K 60Hz displays under $150

I could not place a quote — the store cannot confirm any dock under $150 fits two 4K 60 Hz displays.

**What the store confirmed**
| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| Laptop port | USB-C (DisplayPort Alt Mode) |
| Displays needed at 4K 60 Hz | 2, simultaneous |
| Budget | under $150.00 |

**What it checked, and why nothing qualifies**
- Demo Dock Duo Lite — $89.00 → **incompatible**: port passes, but listed at 1 display at 4K 60 Hz.
- Demo Dock Travel — $39.00 and Demo Dock Solo — $59.00 → **not viable**: 1 video output each (1 display at 4K 60 Hz).
- Demo Dock Duo (OAW-DOCK-04) — $129.00 → **unverifiable**: USB-C DP Alt Mode passes and 90 W power delivery passes, but the store has **not filled in `max_displays_4k60`** for this item, so two 4K 60 Hz displays cannot be confirmed.

**The missing spec:** the 4K 60 Hz display count (`max_displays_4k60`) for the Demo Dock Duo. Since a dock that only fits must be confirmed, I have not ordered anything.

Your options, if you want to continue:
1. Have the store record the Duo's 4K 60 Hz display count — then it can re-check and quote.
2. Accept one display at 4K 60 Hz with the second at lower resolution (note: nothing under $150 is listed at 2 × 4K 60 Hz).
3. Raise the budget above $150 so it can search for a documented 2 × 4K 60 Hz dock.

Tell me which you prefer and I'll take it back to the store — the order stays with you to confirm.
